primary_statement: Steve Fisk, Polynomials, roots, and interlacing, Conjecture 21.90, printed p650 (PDF p663); Hurwitz stability definition, printed p619 (PDF p632).
novelty_scope: Exact verification of an existing posted counterexample, no new mathematical result or priority claim. D2,D3 occur in the primary source example; the posted solution replaces its semidefinite D1 with diag(1,2,1).
source_caveat: The primary source calls its nearby example minors stable despite displaying a cubic with a positive real zero; we do not rely on that assertion. Our strict-positive-definiteness and exact coefficient calculation are independently certified.
